style: Quiet editorial interior photography for an independent senior business advisor. Photorealistic, natural window light, shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, real materials (wool, oak, linen, paper, ceramic). Colour grade: deep navy shadows (#0B1033 family), soft cool lavender-white highlights (#F7F4FF), restrained and calm, a faint violet cast in the shadows. No people, no faces, no hands, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no screens showing content, no watermarks, no illustration, no CGI look.

images.name: two-chairs
images.alt: Two armchairs facing each other beside a tall window in early light
images.prompt: Two simple upholstered armchairs angled toward each other beside a tall window in a quiet private office, early morning light falling across a wool rug and a low oak table between them, sheer linen curtain, deep navy wall in shadow on the left, lots of calm negative space on the left third of the frame.

images.name: notebook
images.alt: An open notebook and a pen on an oak desk in window light
images.prompt: An open blank-paged notebook with a fountain pen resting on it on an oak desk, a ceramic cup just out of focus behind, soft side light from a window, cool lavender highlights and navy shadows, viewed from a low three-quarter angle.

images.name: office-dusk
images.alt: An empty office at dusk with a single desk lamp still on
images.prompt: An empty, tidy executive office at blue-hour dusk seen through its open door, a single warm desk lamp still lit on the desk, the chair pushed slightly back, city dusk glow in the window but no recognisable skyline, deep navy shadows, quiet and contemplative.

images.name: two-cups
images.alt: Two coffee cups on a small table mid-conversation
images.prompt: Two ceramic coffee cups, one half finished, on a small round oak table with a folded pair of reading glasses beside them, two chair edges just visible, window light from the right, soft lavender-white highlights, viewed from slightly above, suggesting a conversation in progress.
